fusions.name: Stoop of Cinders
fusions.desc: A burning dive on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Plumage
fusions.desc: Sheds 4 of your feathers in a spread, each of which deals 3 damage. Each use costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Soaring Pyre
fusions.desc: Looses a firebird for 10 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it dives on an enemy within 5 tiles, which deals 4 damage with a 35% chance to set the target [Burning] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of the Ashes
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
